```{r}
library(GLMsData) # For the data
library(performance) # For the overdispersion check
library(broom) # To use tidy()
library(janitor) # For clean_names()
library(tidyverse) 

data(ants)
```


```{r}
forest_ants <- ants |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(habitat == "Forest")

glimpse(forest_ants)
```

```{r}
ant_model <- glm(
  srich ~ latitude,
  family = poisson,
  data = forest_ants
)
```

```{r}
tidy(
  ant_model,
  conf.int = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
tidy(
  ant_model,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  exponentiate = TRUE
)
```

Hypothesis test for $\beta_1 = 0$

```{r}
reduced_ant_model <- glm(
  srich ~ 1,
  family = poisson,
  data = forest_ants
)

anova(reduced_ant_model, ant_model, test = "LRT")
```




```{r}
check_overdispersion(ant_model)
```
